query: SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name
result: tab01(fld001 atom id PRIMARY KEY, fld002 molecule reference to tab04.fld002, fld003 element); tab02(fld004 bond id PRIMARY KEY, fld002 molecule reference to tab04.fld002, fld005 bond type); tab03(fld001 atom id, fld006 atom id, fld004 bond id, PRIMARY KEY(fld001,fld006), all three columns referencing tab01/tab01/tab02); tab04(fld002 molecule id PRIMARY KEY, fld007 label)
validation_method: Schema inspection via sqlite_master; foreign-key declarations confirm atom->molecule, bond->molecule and incidence->atom/bond links

query: SELECT 'tab01', COUNT(*) FROM tab01 UNION ALL SELECT 'tab02', COUNT(*) FROM tab02 UNION ALL SELECT 'tab03', COUNT(*) FROM tab03 UNION ALL SELECT 'tab04', COUNT(*) FROM tab04
result: tab01 = 12,333 atom rows; tab02 = 12,379 bond rows; tab03 = 24,758 incidence rows; tab04 = 343 labeled molecule rows
validation_method: Row counts aggregated over all four tables

query: SELECT fld007, COUNT(*) FROM tab04 GROUP BY fld007
result: '+' = 152 molecules; '-' = 191 molecules; no null or empty labels; total 343

query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fld002) FROM tab01; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fld002) FROM tab02; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab04; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab01 WHERE fld002 NOT IN (SELECT fld002 FROM tab04); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab02 WHERE fld002 NOT IN (SELECT fld002 FROM tab04)
result: 444 molecules have atoms; 444 molecules have bonds; 343 molecules are labeled. Unlabeled: 101 molecules, 3,222 atoms, 3,223 bonds. Labeled subset: 9,111 atoms and 9,156 bonds. No labeled molecule lacks atoms or bonds.
validation_method: Set comparison between structure tables and the label table

query: SELECT fld003, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT fld002) AS molecules FROM tab01 GROUP BY fld003 ORDER BY n DESC
validation_method: Grouped counts of atoms and distinct molecules by element symbol

query: SELECT fld005, COUNT(*) FROM tab02 GROUP BY fld005 ORDER BY fld005
result: '-' = 10,528; '=' = 1,844; '#' = 6; empty string = 1 (bond TR345_7_10 in unlabeled molecule TR345). Within labeled molecules: '-' = 7,743; '=' = 1,408; '#' = 5.
validation_method: Grouped counts over all bonds and over labeled-molecule bonds

query: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT fld004) FROM tab03; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT fld004, COUNT(*) c FROM tab03 GROUP BY fld004 HAVING c <> 2); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT fld001, fld006, fld004, COUNT(*) c FROM tab03 GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING c > 1)
result: 24,758 rows for 12,379 distinct bonds; 0 bonds with a row count other than 2; 0 duplicate (atom, counterpart, bond) triples. The incidence table is symmetric: every bond appears once from each endpoint.
validation_method: Cardinality and duplicate checks per bond

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab02 WHERE fld004 NOT IN (SELECT fld004 FROM tab03); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT fld004 FROM tab03) WHERE fld004 NOT IN (SELECT fld004 FROM tab02); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab03 WHERE fld001 NOT IN (SELECT fld001 FROM tab01) OR fld006 NOT IN (SELECT fld001 FROM tab01)
result: 0 bonds missing incidence rows; 0 incidence bonds missing from the bond table; 0 incidence rows referencing unknown atoms. Every bond has exactly two endpoint atoms of the same molecule.
validation_method: Referential integrity checks across tab02, tab03 and tab01

query: WITH p AS (SELECT fld004, fld002, substr(fld004, length(fld002)+2) rest FROM tab02), q AS (SELECT fld004, fld002, substr(rest,1,instr(rest,'_')-1) a, substr(rest,instr(rest,'_')+1) b FROM p), r AS (SELECT q.*, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.fld001=q.fld002||'_'||q.a THEN 1 END) has_a, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.fld001=q.fld002||'_'||q.b THEN 1 END) has_b FROM q LEFT JOIN tab03 t ON t.fld004=q.fld004 GROUP BY q.fld004) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r WHERE has_a=0 OR has_b=0
result: 0 bonds whose identifier parts are absent from the incidence table. All 12,379 bond identifiers encode the molecule identifier plus the two endpoint atom sequence numbers, matching the incidence rows.
validation_method: Parsed each bond identifier and matched both parts against the incidence atoms

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab01 WHERE substr(fld001,1,instr(fld001,'_')-1) <> fld002; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab02 WHERE substr(fld004,1,instr(fld004,'_')-1) <> fld002; SELECT MIN(fld002), MAX(fld002) FROM tab04
result: 0 atom prefix mismatches; 0 bond prefix mismatches; molecule identifiers range from TR000 to TR501. Every atom and bond identifier starts with its molecule identifier.
validation_method: Prefix consistency check for every atom and bond row

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab01 a WHERE a.fld001 NOT IN (SELECT fld001 FROM tab03); SELECT a.fld003, COUNT(*) FROM tab01 a WHERE a.fld001 NOT IN (SELECT fld001 FROM tab03) GROUP BY a.fld003; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab01 a WHERE a.fld001 NOT IN (SELECT fld001 FROM tab03) AND a.fld002 IN (SELECT fld002 FROM tab04)
result: 49 atoms have no incidence row: cl 5, h 7, k 1, na 35, zn 1. 38 of them lie in labeled molecules. All 35 sodium atoms are unbonded.
validation_method: Anti-join between the atom table and the incidence table, grouped by element and label membership

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT fld001 FROM tab03 GROUP BY fld001 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1); SELECT MAX(c) FROM (SELECT fld001, COUNT(*) c FROM tab03 GROUP BY fld001)
result: 5,745 atoms appear in more than one incidence row; the maximum number of bond incidences per atom is 4.

query: SELECT fld003, COUNT(DISTINCT fld002) FROM tab01 GROUP BY fld003; SELECT a.fld002, t.fld007, COUNT(*) FROM tab01 a LEFT JOIN tab04 t ON a.fld002=t.fld002 WHERE a.fld003='f' GROUP BY a.fld002
result: Molecules per element: h 426, c 438, o 311, n 233, cl 155, s 70, br 18, na 19, p 28, f 4, i 2, si 2, sn 2, cu 1, zn 1, y 1, te 1, pb 1, k 1, ca 1, b 1. Fluorine occurs in 4 molecules: TR034 (label '-', 3 atoms), TR106 (no label, 1 atom), TR195 (label '-', 3 atoms), TR450 (label '+', 4 atoms). Iodine occurs in TR110 (label '-', 3 atoms) and TR340 (no label, 3 atoms).
validation_method: Distinct-molecule counts per element and per-molecule presence inspection

query: SELECT b.fld005, t.fld007, COUNT(*) FROM tab02 b JOIN tab04 t ON b.fld002=t.fld002 GROUP BY b.fld005, t.fld007 ORDER BY b.fld005, t.fld007
result: single '-' bond: carcinogenic 3,078 / non-carcinogenic 4,665; double '=' bond: carcinogenic 634 / non-carcinogenic 774; triple '#' bond: carcinogenic 3 / non-carcinogenic 2. All 9,156 labeled-molecule bonds carry a known molecule label.
validation_method: Cross-tabulation of bond type against molecule label
